demos.title: Your own commands as tools
demos.blurb: A shell command declared in koda.toml is called like a built-in — and shows up in /tools.

files.koda.toml:
# Custom tools are shell commands the agent can call like a built-in.
[[tools]]
name = "check"
description = "Run this project's gate: formatting, lint and the test suite, stopping at the first failure."
command = "echo 'fmt ok' && echo 'clippy ok' && echo '3 tests passed'"
mutating = false

steps: type:does this project pass its checks?
